description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transform that outputs script tags for scripts to be included at the footer of a web page, based on script links collected from the request object.

classes.name: ScriptTagsFooterTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker template transform class that renders footer script tags based on request data.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that, upon closing, writes script tags for footer scripts collected from the request.
